commit.message:
Remove execute_unknown from the IDL compiler

execute_unknown was a post-hoc "undo" mechanism on the Executable
interface: every assignable node had to implement it to set variables
to nil (unknown) when traversing conditional branches whose conditions
are not compile-time-known. It was error-prone (the fadd.s bug showed
it could be silently bypassed) and semantically wrong for
"branch may or may not execute" cases.

Replacements:
- Add snapshot_values/restore_values to SymbolTable so IfBodyAst#prune
  and ForLoopAst#prune can snapshot outer-scope Var values before
  pruning a body and restore them afterward, then call
  nullify_assignments to mark loop/branch-assigned vars unknown.
- Add nullify_assignments overrides to all assignment node types
  (AryElementAssignmentAst, AryRangeAssignmentAst, FieldAssignmentAst,
  MultiVariableAssignmentAst, PostIncrementExpressionAst,
  PostDecrementExpressionAst) so ConditionalStatementAst#execute and
  IfAst#prune can precisely nullify only the variables a branch would
  assign, without attempting to execute the branch.
- Fix AryRangeAssignmentAst#execute to mutate the existing Var directly
  instead of pushing a shadowing Var via symtab.add, so snapshot/restore
  correctly undoes the mutation. Also fix the off-by-one in the bit-range
  mask formula.
- IfBodyAst#prune gains a restore: parameter; known-true/false branches
  in IfAst#prune pass restore: false so their assignments persist.

All execute_unknown implementations and the interface method are deleted.
Regression tests added for ConditionalStatementAst, ForLoopAst,
AryRangeAssignmentAst, and AryRangeAssignmentAst#execute value correctness.

commit.message:
Improve FP implementation, IDL type checking, and config validation error messages

This commit enhances the floating-point (FP) implementation and improves
error reporting across the codebase:

- Add count_leading_zeros_64 function to fix f32_muladd implementation
- Add Zcf extension to RV32/RV64 test configs
- Improve IDL type checking: memoize types per symtab, add runtime checks
- Enhance config validation error messages: show failing conjuncts instead
  of full minimized conditions
- Fix Docker build to cache mise installation and support MISE_GITHUB_TOKEN
- Add comprehensive tests for failing_conjuncts logic
